claim_being_audited: That rejecting the vendor was compliant because admissible due-diligence evidence showed a material unresolved risk, specifically an informal undocumented quality process, a storage-control inconsistency, and notice that approval should not proceed without further follow-up if storage controls remained unresolved.
specific_concerns: The available record is only an actor summary, not the underlying evidence.
The policy requires a material unresolved risk, but materiality is not clearly established in the summarized record.
The cited quality-process gap and questionnaire inconsistency support follow-up or escalation, but policy text says those facts alone do not prove a reject-level control failure.
The packet itself concedes there is no formally logged failed control test.
The sourcing analyst recommendation appears conditional on unresolved storage controls and reads closer to follow-up before approval than a clear rejection directive.
unsupported_claims: Any stronger implication that the file proves a confirmed reject-level control failure.
Any claim that the admissible record clearly establishes materiality rather than merely unresolved questions.
Any reliance on unlogged private security-review results would be unsupported under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: The underlying contents of BPROC-003-B through BPROC-003-E, not just the summary.
A documented materiality assessment showing why the unresolved issues rose to reject-level risk.
Any formal procurement rule or approval threshold stating that unresolved storage-control inconsistencies require rejection rather than escalation.
Any admissible record showing the inconsistency remained unresolved after follow-up.
Any formally logged control test failure, if one exists.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows a material unresolved risk sufficient to justify rejection.
Treat quality-process gaps and questionnaire inconsistencies as support for follow-up or escalation unless the record also establishes materiality or unresolved status at decision time.
Do not credit private security-review results unless they are formally logged.
Discount claims that exceed the summarized evidence, especially claims of confirmed control failure.
Because this is actor-summary-only, require clearer linkage than usual between cited facts and the reject decision.
